name: Claude Ringheart
original_name: クロード・リングハルト
source: Claude is a member of the Bee Hive Gang and cares for [url=/c23729]Chitoge[/url] deeply. Due to this, he constantly keeps a close eye on [url=/c23699]Raku[/url]. He is one of the few characters that deeply believes that Raku's and Chitoge's relationship is fake. Despite this he is shown to be slightly dense, and was completely clueless of [url=/c23723]Seishirou's[/url] real gender, despite being the person who trained and named her.
